CANSLIM-Top100-US v1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the CANSLIM-Top100-US skill.
- Enables analysis of the top 100 S&P 500 companies using CANSLIM-style signals.
- Runs a local Python script to rank and summarize the strongest candidates in a Markdown table.
- Provides clear execution steps, output format, guidance on interpreting results, and detailed error handling.
